Mr. Scott's body was discovered at the Grand Hotel in Honolulu, after the major project launch.
Security camera footage shows that Mr. Scott went directly to the Grand Hotel after the major project launch and never left.
Initial examination indicates that the time of death was 8 pm.
Autopsy results show that the murder weapon was a .38 revolver.

messages.text: What evidence points to Evans? Cook also attended the cocktail hour, and the autopsy showed a .38.

The clues I have point to Evans having a contract-related motive tied to the project launch, plus confirmed Honolulu presence. Cook also had opportunity and owned a .38, so the evidence isn't conclusive—but Evans seems to have the stronger motive.
